Details

CZ Tactical Sport, Shadow 2, Beretta 92fs LTT, Beretta 92fs Inox Vertec, and Sig Sauer 226 XFIVE for sale
Preferred FFL
Burbank FFL
Moving out of CA and decided to let go of my collection. Make an offer, let's make a deal. Buyer pays all fees.

CZ Tactical Sport - $2,500 $2,200:
Discontinued CZ Tactical Sport featuring a CZ Custom extended safety for sale. This is an excellent competition ready pistol with an outstanding trigger, perfect for anyone looking to get into competitive shooting or who wants a sweet range toy.

The pistol shows small cosmetic wear but functions flawlessly.
Includes:
  • CZC extended safety
  • Original factory case
  • (3) 10-round magazines
--------------
CZ Shadow 2 - $2,800:
Here's your chance to own an off-roster, discontinued Urban Grey CZ Shadow 2. This pistol has been a safe queen, is in excellent condition, and is becoming increasingly difficult to find.
Includes:
• Original factory box
• (1) 10-round magazine
• Extra shock buffs
-----------------
226 XFIVE - $6,000 $5,700:
Don't miss your chance to own the pistol Mike Lowrey used in Bad Boys for Life. This stainless model is off-roster and discontinued by SIG. In great condition with some holster wear. The Vortex 5 MOA red dot is included. Also included is the factory extended magazine release and the short magazine release, a SIG-installed upgrade that is not available for retail purchase.
Includes:
• Original Custom Works lockable hard case (no code has been set)
• Factory iron sights
• Standard magazine release
• Extended and regular mag release
• Vortex 5 MOA red dot (with box and factory accessories)
• No magazines
---------------------------------------
92FS LTT - $2,800 $2,500:
This model is off roster with the timeless slide that is being discontinued by Beretta. The gun has the LTT trigger job in a bag for a crazy smooth trigger. This gun is a great shooter with some holster wear.
Included:
• (3) 10 round mags
• Lok Grips Palm Swell Veloce
• Original grips
• Original magazine release
• Extended adjustable magazine release
• Langdon Tactical trigger job in a bag
• Original parts
• Original hard case
------------------------------------
Inox 92FS Vertec - $3,000 $2,700:
The original Inox Vertec was produced in limited batches before being permanently discontinued and is one of the hardest to find.
Condition: Great overall shape with minor cosmetic wear.
Includes:
• Installed "G" Conversion (decocker-only)
• Viridian X5L Green Laser/Light
• Original Factory Case
• (1) 10 round Magazine
